How it works

From an agent's question
to usable web context.

Raavvi acts as an integration layer between your AI application and public web content. Your agent requests information; the API returns material your application can work with.

01

Your application makes an API call

Send a query or URL from your backend with your API credentials.

02

The web is searched and processed

Retrieve relevant sources and extract useful page content for the task.

03

Your agent uses the response

Pass the structured information to your model, retrieval system or automated workflow.

A simple integration model

One API call.
Your agent's next step.

The example below illustrates a server-side request pattern. Replace the placeholder base URL and credentials with the production API details supplied for your integration.

PYTHON · REQUEST EXAMPLE
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "YOUR_API_BASE_URL/v1/search",
    headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
    },
    json={
        "query": "AI agent frameworks",
        "max_results": 5
    },
    timeout=30
)

web_context = response.json()
# Pass web_context to your agent or model
